title: Witness XZ Andromedae Wink
explanation:
# XZ Andromedae: A Cosmic Wink

A distant pair of stars orbits so close together and at just the right angle that we see them periodically eclipse each other—one star regularly blocking the light of its hotter, brighter companion in a cosmic wink that repeats like clockwork. Scientists analyzing this celestial dance discovered evidence for two additional stars lurking in the system, all captured by citizen astronomers using free software that tracks tiny changes in starlight to reveal these hidden cosmic dramas.
